delta: Looking at this intake for CRM-31 (PLATFORM-16-W
EB), the story focuses on building designed empty, loading, and error state UI primitives. The implementation depends

on:

1. Understanding the existing state machine in `useRequest`
2. Extracting a message mapper from `SignInPage` to make

it shared
3. Type-safe exhaustive mapping of `ApiErrorCode` 
4. Localization of all UI strings into en

/ar
5. Token-only color usage
6. Deciding where primitives live relative

to the string guard
7. Following established UI primitive patterns

The critical technical hints emphasize using `Record<Api
ErrorCode, ...>` typing so TypeScript enforces exhaustiveness (failing at `tsc -b` if a code is forgotten), and resolving the string guard
scope question—whether primitives in `shared/ui/` need the guard extended or should move elsewhere

reasoning:
This story builds three designed UI primitives (empty, loading, error states) that render the existing useRequest state machine exhaustively. Files are grouped by criticality:

**Plan & Rules** (read first): `.squad/plan-lessons.md` contains defect patterns to avoid from prior reviews—explicitly mandatory reading before drafting.

**State Machine & Error Handling** (core contract): `useRequest.ts` (line 7, status union), `errors.ts` (ApiErrorCode union), and `SignInPage.tsx` + test (has the local messageFor function to extract and refactor into shared utility, typed as Record<ApiErrorCode, string> to fail tsc if codes drift).

**String Guard Decision** (critical design choice): `no-hardcoded-strings.test.ts` defines which directories are scanned; drafter must decide whether to extend the guard or place primitive labels elsewhere. Strings themselves live in `shared/i18n/` (en.ts, ar.ts, index.tsx with defineLocale pattern that enforces exhaustive keys).

**Design Token Enforcement** (color-only constraint): `tokens.css` is the sole place for color definitions; `tokens.test.ts` scans all web/src to prove compliance.

**UI Primitive Patterns** (structure to follow): Button, Card, Stack, Text, Field, and `primitives.test.tsx` show existing component shape, CSS structure, and test patterns for the new primitives.

**Testing & Build Infrastructure**: `render.tsx`, `setup.ts` (test utilities from CRM-26); `tsconfig.json` ensures TypeScript strictness for exhaustive type checking (critical for Record<ApiErrorCode> enforcement); `package.json` (build/test commands).

**Acceptance Criteria & Architecture**: `criteria/platform.md` (section PLATFORM-16-WEB), `architecture.md` (confirms web code location and structure rules).

delta: # Story 16 — agent: empty, loading and error states are designed, not accidental (Story: CR

M-31)

## Prerequisites

- **PLATFORM-12-WEB completed** — the desk shell exists (`web/src/app/desk-

shell/DeskShell.tsx`). This story adds primitives the shell and later screens will use.
- **PLATFORM-13-ALL (
CRM-28) hardcoded-strings guard** — `web/src/pages/no-hardcoded-strings.test.ts` currently scans `['pages', 'features

', 'app']`. Any decision this story makes about where the primitives live must reconcile with that scan.
- Coordinate with the owner of `web/src/shared/api/err
ors.ts` (`ApiErrorCode` union) — this story consumes it exhaustively; adding a ninth code must not sl

ip past `tsc -b`.
- **Read first:** `.squad/plan-lessons.md` (rules L-6 — hardcoded-string scan holes, and

L-15 — vitest does not typecheck, `npm run build` is the proof).

---

## Story Goal

Ship three shared UI primitives — **empty**
, **error**, **loading (skeleton)** — that any web screen renders when it needs to express one of the four
`useRequest` statuses (`idle`, `loading`, `success`, `error`). Move sign-in's ad-hoc `messageFor(code
, t)` switch into a single shared, exhaustively-typed error-message map keyed by `ApiErrorCode`. Register all sentences in both `en`
and `ar` resource files so `defineLocale`'s missing/extra-keys check enforces them in lockstep. Make it typecheck-hard to add a new `ApiErr

orCode` without adding its message.

Out of scope (from intake, restate for the executor):
- No real desk screen chang

es beyond sign-in's message wiring.
- No changes to `useRequest`'s status union, `ApiError` shape, or `ApiErrorCode` union.
- No language switching, no loc

ale date/number formatting, no 401 redirect behaviour.
- No `api/` or `android/` change. No new dependency.

---

## Context — Read These Files First

1. `web
/src/shared/hooks/useRequest.ts` — read the whole file (~1.5 KB). Confirm the exported status union at line 7 is `'idle' | 'loading' | 'success
' | 'error'` and that the file comment names it the single place a screen expresses loading. The primitives render **

for** these statuses; they do not add a parallel state model.
2. `web/src/shared/api/errors.ts` — read the whole file (~1.2 KB). Locate the exported `ApiError
Code` union (the eight documented codes) and the `ApiError` shape. The new message map is typed `Record<ApiErrorCode, (t

) => string>` against this union.
3. `web/src/pages/sign-in/SignInPage.tsx` — read the whole file. Find the local `messageFor(code, t)` switch. Note

**exactly** which sentences it produces per code so we can move them verbatim into `shared/i18n/{en,ar}.ts`.
4. `web/src/shared/i18n/en.ts`
and `web/src/shared/i18n/ar.ts` — read both. Note the current top-level keys and how sign-in strings are grouped. Add the new keys under a

sibling group (e.g. `errors.*` and `states.*`) in **both** files.
5. `web/src/shared/i18n/index.tsx` — grep
for `defineLocale`. Confirm it treats missing or extra keys as a build error; the exhaustive `Record<ApiErrorCode, …>` in TypeScript plus `

defineLocale`'s key parity is what makes forgetting a sentence fail `npm run build`.
6. `web/src/pages/no-hardcoded-strings.test.ts` — read the whole file. Conf
irm the scan roots are `['pages', 'features', 'app']`. Decide (see § Implementation) whether to add `'shared/ui'` to the ro
ots or keep primitives literal-free (props-only). The primitives will take their sentences as props/children, so their **own

** files have no literals; the sentences live in `shared/i18n` which is already covered by `defineLocale`.
7. `web/src/shared/ui/index.ts` and existing primitives (`Button
.tsx`, `Card.tsx`, `Stack.tsx`, `Heading.tsx`, `Text.tsx`, `Field.tsx`, `Input.tsx`) — read `index.ts` and one represent
ative primitive (`Card.tsx`). Match their file layout, css-module pattern (`Foo.t

sx` + `Foo.css`), and export style.
8. `web/src/shared/ui/tokens.css` and `web/src/shared/ui/tokens.test.ts` — read both. Every colour (
including the skeleton shimmer) must be a token; `tokens.test.ts` scans all of `web/src` for stray colour liter

als (D-1). Add any new token here.
9. `web/src/shared/ui/primitives.test.tsx` — read the whole file. This is the pattern to follow when

adding tests for the new primitives.
10. `web/src/pages/sign-in/SignInPage.test.tsx` — read the whole file. It exercises `messageFor` today; update it to

prove sign-in still renders the same sentences after the message map moves to `shared/`.
11. `.squad/plan-lessons.md` — grep for `L-6` and `L-

15`. Cite them in this plan's Verification Steps.
12. `scripts/backlog.txt` — grep for `PLATFORM-16-WEB` and `PLATFORM-12-

WEB` to confirm the full-name ids used in commits and doc references.

---

## Product rules (from story)

Current: sign-in owns its own `messageFor` switch; there

are no shared empty/error/loading primitives.
New:
- One shared error-message map keyed exhaustively by `ApiErrorCode`.
- Three shared primitives: `EmptyState`, `
ErrorState`, `SkeletonBlock` (name TBD in § 2), rendered by scre

ens off the `useRequest` status.
- Loading state reserves the same shape as the content it becomes — **no layout jump**.
- Every colour used

by any new primitive is a `--` token in `tokens.css`.

---

## Frontend Tasks

_No backend changes required

. No `android/` changes. No new dependency._

### 1 — Shared error-message map keyed by `ApiErrorCode`

**Create file:** `web/src/shared/api/error-messages.ts`

- Import `ApiErrorCode` from `./errors`.
- Import the translator type from `web/src/shared/i18n` (wh

atever `useT()` / `defineLocale` returns; match the shape sign-in uses today).
- Export:

  ```ts
  import type

ared/i18n`.

### 2 — Three shared state primitives

For each primitive, follow the `Card.tsx` + `Card.css` pattern already
in `web/src/shared/ui/`. Each takes its text via props/children so the file itself has **no** string literals (this

is the answer to the L-6 hole — primitives are literal-free; the sentences live in `shared/i18n`, which `defineLocale` already enforces in lockstep).

**Create files:**

- `web/src/shared/ui/EmptyState.tsx` + `EmptyState.css`

  Props: `title: ReactNode`, `body?: ReactNode`, `action?: ReactNode` (the "next action
" button provided by the caller). Renders a `Card`-shaped block using existing t

okens.

- `web/src/shared/ui/ErrorState.tsx` + `ErrorState.css`

  Props: `title: ReactNode`, `body: ReactNode` (the sentence from `errorMessageFor`), `onRetry?: () => void`

, `retryLabel?: ReactNode`. When `onRetry` is set, render a retry `Button`.

- `web/src/shared/ui/SkeletonBlock.tsx` + `SkeletonBlock.css`

  Props: `height?: string
`, `width?: string`, `radius?: string`, `count?: number`. The css **reserves the shape** of the content that is coming; add a `/* Reserving
the shape here so the page does not jump when success arrives — do not simplify to a spinner. */` comment above the r

ule. The shimmer uses tokens from `tokens.css` only.

**Update file:** `web/src/shared/ui/index.ts` — re-export the three new primitives alongside the existing

ones. Match the current export style.

**Update file:** `web/src/shared/ui/tokens.css` — add tokens for any new colour used by `SkeletonBlock` (e.g. `--color
-skeleton-base`, `--color-skeleton-shimmer`). No colour literal may live outside this file (D-1 is enforced by `tokens.test.ts`).

### 3 — i18n sentences in both languages

**Update files:** `web/src/shared/i18n/en.ts` and `web/src/shared/i18n/ar.ts`

- Under an `errors` group
, add one key per `ApiErrorCode` value (mirror the code names from `errors.ts`). The English sentences are the ones currently produced by `messageFor`

in `SignInPage.tsx` — copy them **verbatim** to preserve today's sign-in output.
- Under a `states` group, add the placeholder sentences the
primitives read when a caller does not supply its own (or leave the primitives text-ag

nostic and register only what the current sign-in call site actually needs — pick one and be explicit; do not add unused keys).
- `def

ineLocale` enforces missing/extra key parity between `en` and `ar` in lockstep; that is the mechanism that makes forgetting an Arabic translation fail the build.

### 4 —

Lift sign-in's `messageFor` onto the shared map

**Update file:** `web/src/pages/sign-in/SignInPage.tsx`

- Delete the local `messageFor(code, t)` switch.
- Import `errorMessageFor` from `web

/src/shared/api/error-messages`.
- At the call site, replace `messageFor(code, t)` with `errorMessageFor[code](t)`.
- **Do not change what sign-in renders today.** The visible sentences must

be byte-for-byte identical.

### 5 — Hardcoded-strings guard reconciliation (L-6)

**Update file:** `web/src/pages/no-hardcoded-strings.test.ts`

- The primitives take

their sentences via props, so their files contain no user-visible literals. The sentences live in `shared/i18n`, which `defineLocale` covers.
- **Ch
osen path:** keep the scan roots at `['pages', 'features', 'app']` and add an inline comment above the roots naming this
decision: primitives in `shared/ui/` are text-agnostic; if a future primitive ever bakes in a literal, the review must
add `'shared/ui'` to the roots. Do **not** silently widen the scan without a corresponding primitives

audit.
- If a reviewer prefers the other path (widen to `'shared/ui'`), swap the comment for the widening in a single comm

it and re-run — but do not do both.

### 6 — Fourth criterion: the review affordance

Per the intake, do **not** invent a weak mechanical

guard that pretends to enforce "every screen has all three states". The enforcement is:

1. `useRequest` is the only status

source (already true).
2. The three primitives are the easiest thing to reach for.
3. Review can point at each primitive by

name in a diff.

Add a short note to `docs/architecture.md` (a single paragraph under the existing web
section) naming the three primitives and stating that a screen using `useRequest` should render each of them for its `loading`, `error`, and empty-`success` branches. **Do not**

restate anything already in taxonomy or architecture; add one paragraph and link out.

---

## Edge Cases & Failure Modes

- **New
`ApiErrorCode` added to the union but no message registered** — `tsc -b` fails at `web/src/shared/api/error-messages.ts` because `Record<ApiErrorCode, …>

` requires every arm. Verified by `npm run build` (L-15: vitest does not typecheck).
- **New `errors.<code>` key added to `en.ts` but not `ar.ts` (or vice versa)**

— `defineLocale` in `web/src/shared/i18n/index.tsx` fails with a missing/extra key error. Same mechanism sign-in relies on today.
- **A

colour literal sneaks into `SkeletonBlock.css`** — `web/src/shared/ui/tokens.test.ts` scans `web/src` and fails (D-1).
- **A primitive file gains a user-visible literal**
— the current scan does not cover `shared/ui/`; caught only by review. The comment added in § 5 is the guardrail. If this happens tw

ice, widen the scan.
- **Loading is a spinner instead of a skeleton** — allowed by types, forbidden by the design comment in `SkeletonBlock.css`.

Caught in review.
- **Sign-in's rendered sentences change** — caught by `web/src/pages/sign-in/SignInPage.test.tsx` (unchanged assertions).
- **R
TL layout** — primitives use existing `Stack` / logical CSS properties as the current primitives do; verify `ar`

locale shape matches `en` in `primitives.test.tsx` style.
- **A caller forgets `onRetry`** — `ErrorState` renders no button; that is the documented sh

ape. Caller decides whether retry applies.

---

## Test Plan

1. **New:** `web/src/shared/ui/EmptyState.test.tsx` (or
extend `primitives.test.tsx`) — renders title/body/action; matches snapshot of expected shape; no colour literals (covered ind

irectly by `tokens.test.ts`).
2. **New:** `web/src/shared/ui/ErrorState.test.tsx` — renders body sentence; renders retry button only when `onRetry` is

set; clicking retry invokes it once.
3. **New:** `web/src/shared/ui/SkeletonBlock.test.tsx` — renders the requested `count` of blocks; asserts the reserved height

/width props reach the DOM (so a future refactor cannot silently drop them).
4. **New:** `web/src/shared/api/error-messages.test
.ts` — for each value of `ApiErrorCode`, `errorMessageFor[code](t)` returns a non-empty string using the `en` locale, and a non-empty string using the `ar` locale. I
terate the union values via a runtime array whose type is asserted `readonly ApiErrorCode[]` so adding a

code without updating the test list also fails typecheck.
5. **Update:** `web/src/pages/sign-in/SignInPage.test.tsx` — the assertions on

rendered error sentences must pass unchanged after `messageFor` is deleted. Adjust imports only.
6. **Exist
ing, verify still green:** `web/src/shared/ui/tokens.test.ts`, `web/src/pages/no-hardcoded-strings.test.ts`, `web/src/shared/hooks/useRequest.

test.ts`, `web/src/shared/i18n` locale-parity tests (via `defineLocale`).

---

## Migration / Rollback

- No schema, no config, no w

ire-format change. Rollback = revert the commit.
- Half-applied state to watch: if `errorMessageFor` lands without the `en`/`ar` ke
ys, `defineLocale` will fail at import time and sign-in will not render. Land the i18n keys and the map in the same commit.

---

## Verification Steps

1. **Frontend builds:** `cd web && npm run build` — must pass. This is what proves the exhaustive `Record<ApiErrorCode, …>` (L-15).
2. **Front

end tests:** `cd web && npm test` — all new tests pass; `tokens.test.ts` and `no-hardcoded-strings.test.ts` still green.
3. **Frontend dev sanity:** `cd web && npm run dev` — open sign-in,

trigger each error code the API can return, confirm the sentence is byte-for-byte the same as before this story.
4. **Regression

— hardcoded strings:** `cd web && npx vitest run src/pages/no-hardcoded-strings.test.ts` — passes with the roots unchanged.
5

. **Regression — tokens:** `cd web && npx vitest run src/shared/ui/tokens.test.ts` — passes; no new colour literal outside `tokens.css`.
6. **Regression — loc

ale parity:** `cd web && npx vitest run src/shared/i18n` — passes; every new `errors.*` key exists in both `en` and `ar`.
7. **No AI attribution anywhere:** `git grep -inE "(cla
ude|gpt|copilot|chatgpt|anthropic|openai|ai[- ]assist|ai[- ]generated)" --
':!*.lock' ':!package-lock.json'` — no matches in code

, docs, or `.gitignore` (project rule).
8. **Architecture note:** `cd . && node scripts/verify-architecture.mjs` — pass

es; the one-paragraph addition to `docs/architecture.md` does not break the verifier.
9. **Docs verifier:** `node scripts/verify-docs.mjs` — passes.

---

## Done

Criteria

- [ ] `web/src/shared/api/error-messages.ts` exists and exports `errorMessageFor: Record<ApiErrorCode, (t) => string>`.
- [ ] `web/src/shared/ui
/EmptyState.tsx`, `ErrorState.tsx`, `SkeletonBlock.tsx` (each with a matching `.css`) exist and are exported from `web/src/shared/ui/index.

ts`.
- [ ] `SkeletonBlock.css` contains the design comment naming why it reserves shape and forbidding a

spinner.
- [ ] `web/src/shared/i18n/en.ts` and `ar.ts` each contain one `errors.<code>` sentence per `ApiErrorCode` value; `defineL

ocale` passes.
- [ ] `web/src/pages/sign-in/SignInPage.tsx` no longer defines `messageFor`; it reads from `errorMessageFor`.
- [ ] `SignInPage.test.tsx` assertions

on rendered sentences pass unchanged.
- [ ] Every colour used by the new primitives is a token in `tokens.css`; `tokens.test.ts` passes.
- [ ] `no-hardcoded-strings.test.ts
` passes; either the roots are widened with justification, **or** the comment explaining why they were not is

in the file.
- [ ] `npm run build` in `web/` passes; deleting one entry from `errorMessageFor` demonstrably fails `tsc -b` (sp

ot-check locally, do not commit).
- [ ] `docs/architecture.md` gains one paragraph naming the three primitives as the designed states for `useRequest`-back

ed screens.
- [ ] `git grep` for AI-attribution terms returns nothing.

**STOP HERE. Report to the user and wait for conf
irmation before proceeding to Story 17.**
